summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of David Burns as Chief Operating Officer, effective September 7, 2026, succeeding Andrew Leece who transitions to Head of Strategic Partnerships. The filing details Burns' employment agreement with subsidiary SharonAI Pty Ltd, including AUD$550,000 base salary, short-term and long-term incentive awards up to 150% of base salary, and an indefinite term with probation period. This is a routine executive appointment and compensation arrangement, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is solely a management change that is routine in nature, so no special-situation category applies.
